intro: Prayer is talking to God and listening to God.

prayers.title: Our Father
lines: Our Father, who art in heaven,
thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread,
as we forgive those who trespass against us;
and lead us not into temptation,

prayers.title: Hail Mary
lines: and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
now and at the hour of our death.

prayers.title: Glory Be
lines: as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,

prayers.title: Grace
lines: Bless us, O Lord, and these thy gifts,
which we are about to receive

instructions.order: Tap the prayer lines in the right order. Start with the line at the top.
